author: Eric Skovan
text:
Yes you absolutely need to keep it clear! I originally used clear bandage covers and the first time I did my sensor died prematurely.

I scoured the Abbot website for information and finally, way down in the fine print, I found that it does indeed say that the little hole in the center of the sensors, ‘MUST REMAIN UNCOVERED’.

author: Pamela W Bell
text: I used the clear Tegaderm patches like they use in the hospital to put over an IV. I buy them from Amazon. You can cover up the sensor you don’t have to cut a hole in anything.
